offlineBody: BCS needs a connection to show your work. Document data is never kept on this device. Connect to the internet and try again.
updateReady: A new version of BCS is ready. Save what you are typing before you load it.
installIntro: Once installed, BCS has an icon on your home screen and opens like an app.
iosStep2: Tap the Share button at the bottom of the screen
iosStep3: Choose Add to Home Screen, then tap Add
androidStep2: Tap the three-dot menu at the top right
androidStep3: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen
installLink: How to install on a phone
